advice.not_opened: In the local Studio open a model for the cloud: Settings, Cloud builds, "Models for the cloud".
advice.runner_unpaired: In the local Studio turn on "Build my cloud projects on this machine" and connect to the server: without it the cloud cannot reach your model.
advice.runner_offline: Start the local Studio on this computer and check the network.
advice.runner_paused: The runner is paused: resume it in "My runners".
advice.runner_revoked: The runner is revoked: connect the Studio again in "My runners".
advice.disabled: The administrator turned personal runners off: the model through this Studio is unavailable.
advice.endpoint_unreachable: Start Ollama or another model server on this computer.
advice.no_models: Pull a model in Ollama (for example, ollama pull qwen3) and wait a minute.
advice.no_provider: The cloud knows about the model but does not use it: add a "through my runner" provider in the cloud.
advice.studio_offline: Open the local Studio: the model is unavailable while it is offline.

failure.git_server_unreachable: Could not get the build: the Studio server did not respond. Check your network connection.
failure.network: Could not get the build: no connection to the Studio.
failure.auth_failed: The Studio server did not accept this Studio's sign-in. Sign in to the server again and retry.
failure.cloud_pdf_forbidden: You have no right to read the sources and the result of this project in the cloud, so the build cannot be fetched.
failure.cloud_pdf_checksum_mismatch: The build file arrived damaged and was not saved. Try again.
failure.cloud_pdf_write_failed: Could not write the PDF to disk. Close it in other programs and check free space.
failure.output_path_invalid: The document output path points outside the project folder, so the build was not written.
failure.output_unknown: Could not tell where the document puts its result: it is not in the installed template. Get the project changes or build the document here.
failure.presence_unsupported: The Studio server did not share the project cloud builds: no right to read its sources, or the server is too old.

blocked.not_pdf: The document is not produced as a PDF, so the cloud build cannot be fetched: build it here.
blocked.output_unknown: The cloud build cannot be fetched: the document is not in the installed template.
